mechanism: A private branded binder creates per-operation clock views over shared repository state. Public replacementSeed retains exact shared repository identity; the runtime uses its own clock-bound view. Child authored protocol calls receive the same lexical clock, including under reentrancy.
remainingControls: Remaining plugin/provider/environment/startup lifecycle and full-auth obligations
regressionScope: All 22 current file-session repository/public-runtime tests run against proposal namespaces with original assertion titles/bodies preserved; fixture roots and module loading explicitly adapted. Eight additional controls cover replacement clocks, exact falsy faults, actual persisted expiry, reentrancy and cross-view quarantine/recovery.
